Feature: User Login and Administrator Functions

  Scenario: User can log in with valid credentials
  Given a user with a valid login id and password
  When the user attempts to log in
  Then the user should be granted access to the system

  Scenario Outline: Valid login credentials
  | login id | password |
  | valid_id | valid_pass |
  | invalid_id | valid_pass |
  | valid_id | invalid_pass |

  Scenario: Administrator maintains user credentials
  Given an administrator with user credentials
  When the administrator updates user credentials
  Then the updated credentials should be maintained

  Scenario Outline: Administrator credentials maintenance
  | admin_id | admin_pass |
  | valid_admin_id | valid_admin_pass |
  | invalid_admin_id | valid_admin_pass |
  | valid_admin_id | invalid_admin_pass |

  Scenario: Access to Virtual Clinic Main Menu
  Given a user with valid login
  When the user accesses the main menu
  Then the user should see the main menu options

  Scenario Outline: Main menu access
  | user_id |
  | valid_user_id |
  | invalid_user_id |

  Scenario: Administrator sets up users and passwords
  Given an administrator with access to setup
  When the administrator sets up a user
  Then the user should be able to log in with the provided credentials

  Scenario Outline: Administrator setup
  | admin_id | admin_pass |
  | valid_admin_id | valid_admin_pass |
  | invalid_admin_id | valid_admin_pass |
  | valid_admin_id | invalid_admin_pass |

  | admin_id | admin_pass |

  | invalid_admin_id | valid_admin_pass |
  | valid_admin_id | invalid_admin_pass |

  Scenario: Administrator views/prints invoice
  Given an administrator with access to view/print

  Then the invoice should be displayed/printed

  Scenario Outline: Administrator view/print invoice
  | admin_id | admin_pass |
  | valid_admin_id | valid_admin_pass |
  | invalid_admin_id | valid_admin_pass |
  | valid_admin_id | invalid_admin_pass |

  Scenario: Administrator performs back-ups
  Given an administrator with access to back-up

  Then the system should be backed up

  Scenario Outline: Administrator back-up
  | admin_id | admin_pass |
  | valid_admin_id | valid_admin_pass |
  | invalid_admin_id | valid_admin_pass |
  | valid_admin_id | invalid_admin_pass |

  Given an administrator with access to archive

  Then the patient profiles should be archived

  Scenario Outline: Administrator archive
  | admin_id | admin_pass |
  | valid_admin_id | valid_admin_pass |
  | invalid_admin_id | valid_admin_pass |
  | valid_admin_id | invalid_admin_pass |

  Scenario: Administrator maintains speciality
  Given an administrator with access to maintain speciality
  When the administrator maintains speciality
  Then the speciality should be maintained

  Scenario Outline: Administrator maintain speciality
  | speciality_id | speciality_name | speciality_description |
  | valid_speciality_id | valid_speciality_name | valid_speciality_description |
